claims.claim: MARS improves decision support over LLM-only and RAG baselines.
claims.evidence_summary: Evaluated on 20 stratified cases (2023-2026 chronological decisions) against Zero-Shot LLM and Naive RAG using Groq Qwen-2.5-27B frontier judge. MARS achieved Composite G-Eval of 4.412 vs 2.763 (G1) and 2.763 (G2) with paired bootstrap p < 0.0001 across all 4 dimensions (Action Alignment: 4.300 vs 2.800; Conflict Awareness: 4.950 vs 2.700; Factual Grounding: 4.000 vs 2.200; Risk Foresight: 4.400 vs 3.350; 100% citation validity with 4.65 precedents/case).
